versions.changelog:
**Summary: Expanded privacy and data externalization notes; added experimental dub mode documentation.**

- SKILL.md now clearly details all external network requests and exactly what data is sent to each TTS/ASR provider.
- Added an explicit section describing the experimental dub (voice cloning and translation) mode, including gatekeeping, data sent, required user permissions, and output files.
- The description now highlights which data (such as text and reference audio) is always transmitted for TTS/dub operations and under what circumstances.
- Expanded privacy warnings and requirement for explicit user consent before using voice cloning or dub.
- Removed the previously present skill-card.md file.

Version 1.0.7

- Refactored and unified TTS result caching: segment audio is now cached in tts_segments/cache/ by read text and TTS parameters, not segment index or window.
- Dramatically improves repeatability: segment position changes (e.g. shifting time window or sequence) no longer force unnecessary TTS recomputation.
- Dropped legacy per-segment cache sidecars; cache reuse and invalidation are now reliable across text, TTS settings, and logic changes.
- Introduced stricter over-length (幻读) checks: audio longer than feasible reading speed (with silence budget) is rejected before assemble, with clear retention of rejected audio for inspection.
- Updated and clarified SKILL.md documentation accordingly.

- Improved strict mode: old autoshrink caches are no longer used when strict approval-protection is enabled; only exact matches with the same strategy reuse cache.
- Default over-budget detection strategy updated to `report-over-budget-v2`; strict mode and default mode caches are now strictly separated.
- Enhanced error handling: if assembled voiceover cannot safely fit the time window, TTS now fails immediately with `no_safe_fit`.
- Updated documentation and removed redundant files for clarity.
Authorized ZenStory cold-start distribution; immutable source and preserved notices.
